description: Comprehensive reasoning vault for geometry formulas, perimeter, area of polygons and circles, volume of solids, angle relationships, and composite geometric modeling.

archetypes.name: Perimeter of Rectangles and Regular Polygons
archetypes.coreConcept: Perimeter is the total linear distance around the exterior boundary: P = 2L + 2W.
archetypes.mentalModel: Walking along the fence line of a rectangular enclosure.

archetypes.name: Area of Rectangles and Right Triangles
archetypes.coreConcept: Area measures two-dimensional surface coverage: rectangle area A = L * W, triangle area A = (1/2) * b * h.
archetypes.mentalModel: Tiling a plane with unit square squares versus bisecting a rectangle.
archetypes.governingRelation: A_{\text{rect}} = L \cdot W \land A_{\text{tri}} = \frac{1}{2} b h

archetypes.name: Circumference of Circles and Ratio Invariance
archetypes.coreConcept: The circumference of a circle is proportional to its diameter by constant pi: C = 2*pi*r.
archetypes.mentalModel: Unrolling the outer rim of a circular wheel along a flat path.

archetypes.name: Area of Circles via Radius Squaring
archetypes.coreConcept: The area enclosed by a circle is pi times the square of the radius: A = pi * r^2.
archetypes.mentalModel: Slicing a circle into wedge sectors rearranged into a pseudo-rectangle of width r and length pi*r.

archetypes.name: Volume of Rectangular Solids and Prisms
archetypes.coreConcept: Volume measures three-dimensional space capacity: V = L * W * H.
archetypes.mentalModel: Stacking unit cubic blocks into a three-dimensional rectangular grid.

archetypes.name: Volume of Right Circular Cylinders
archetypes.coreConcept: Volume of a cylinder is base area multiplied by height: V = pi * r^2 * h.
archetypes.mentalModel: Extruding a circular base through vertical height h.

archetypes.name: Complementary and Supplementary Angle Relationships
archetypes.coreConcept: Two angles are complementary if their sum is 90 degrees; supplementary if their sum is 180 degrees.
archetypes.mentalModel: Decomposing a right angle or straight flat line.

archetypes.name: Triangle Interior Angle Sum Invariance
archetypes.coreConcept: The sum of the interior angle measures of any Euclidean triangle is identically 180 degrees.
archetypes.mentalModel: Bringing all three triangle vertices together along a straight line.

archetypes.name: Composite Geometric Area Partition and Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Decompose complex geometric shapes into elementary non-overlapping regions and sum their areas.

archetypes.name: Cylindrical Lateral Surface Area Modeling
archetypes.coreConcept: The lateral surface area of a cylinder unrolls into a rectangle of length 2*pi*r and height h: A_lat = 2*pi*r*h.
archetypes.mentalModel: Unrolling a cylindrical soup can label onto a flat table.
